title: Cardiac Contractility Modulation (CCM) for Heart Failure (HF)
service: Cardiac contractility modulation (CCM) for heart failure

criteria.text: Furnished according to an FDA market-authorized indication; patient meets FDA indications for use
criteria.span: Patients must meet the FDA market-authorized indications for use

criteria.text: Symptomatic despite >= 3 months of optimized GDMT, as determined by the heart team
criteria.span: remain symptomatic despite at least 3 months of optimized guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) as determined by the heart team prior to CCM implantation

criteria.text: Excluded: any contraindication in the FDA labeling
criteria.span: Meet any of the contraindications in the FDA labeling

criteria.text: Furnished in a CMS-approved CED study; not covered outside one
criteria.span: CCM for HF management is not covered for patients outside of a CMS-approved study.

notes: Source text defect: the CED subgroup list (B.2.d) is truncated at 'Age (Stratify' in the downloaded NCD; not tested. FDA labeling details are not in the NCD, so cases state labeled indications/contraindications explicitly.
